summary.purpose: Master orchestration SSIS package for Guidewire PolicyCenter (Source System 3) ETL. Coordinates execution of child extraction packages in foreign-key dependency order, manages audit logging, and provides centralized error handling.
summary.high_level_narrative: The package initiates by logging a 'RUNNING' status to the etl.etl_audit_log table via the CM_DW_PG_Target PostgreSQL connection. It then launches two parallel branches: Extract_Account.dtsx and Extract_Producer.dtsx. Upon completion of both, Extract_Policy.dtsx executes. Subsequently, Extract_Job.dtsx and Extract_Claims.dtsx run in parallel. Extract_Job.dtsx feeds into Extract_PolicyPeriod.dtsx, which then fans out to three parallel packages: Extract_Location.dtsx, Extract_Coverage.dtsx, and Extract_Premium.dtsx. The final stage, Extract_KPI_Aggregates.dtsx, waits for both Extract_Premium.dtsx and Extract_Claims.dtsx to finish. On successful completion of KPI aggregates, the master package updates the audit log to 'COMPLETED'. An OnError event handler captures any failure and presumably logs an error status (though the handler XML is truncated). All child packages execute in-process.
summary.business_domain: Insurance - Policy Administration (Guidewire PolicyCenter) / Data Warehousing ETL

knowledge_profile.purpose: Master orchestration package for Source System 3 (Guidewire PolicyCenter PostgreSQL). Executes all child ETL packages in FK-dependency order: Account/Producer -> Policy -> Job/Claims -> Policy_Period -> Location/Coverage/Premium -> KPI Aggregates. Provides audit logging and centralized error handling.

inputs: PostgreSQL connection parameters (server, port, database, user) via CM_DW_PG_Target

Child SSIS packages: Extract_Account.dtsx, Extract_Producer.dtsx, Extract_Policy.dtsx, Extract_Job.dtsx, Extract_Claims.dtsx, Extract_PolicyPeriod.dtsx, Extract_Location.dtsx, Extract_Coverage.dtsx, Extract_Premium.dtsx, Extract_KPI_Aggregates.dtsx
outputs: Audit log entries in etl.etl_audit_log (start and end records)
Execution of all child ETL packages in defined dependency order

key_logic: 1. Log master package start to etl.etl_audit_log with status RUNNING
2. Execute Extract_Account.dtsx and Extract_Producer.dtsx in parallel (no dependencies between them)
3. After both Account and Producer complete, execute Extract_Policy.dtsx
4. After Policy completes, execute Extract_Job.dtsx and Extract_Claims.dtsx in parallel
6. After PolicyPeriod completes, execute Extract_Location.dtsx, Extract_Coverage.dtsx, Extract_Premium.dtsx in parallel
7. After Premium and Claims both complete, execute Extract_KPI_Aggregates.dtsx
8. Log master package end to etl.etl_audit_log with status COMPLETED
9. On any error, event handler executes EH_MasterFail (SQL task) to handle failure
